prompt_inputs.goal: Create a 2,000 calorie deficit meal plan for weight class compliance while preserving muscle and maintaining boxing performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2,000 calories for the day
Includes high protein content (minimum 150g) to preserve muscle during deficit
Provides balanced macronutrients suitable for athletic performance
Respects all dietary restrictions (no shellfish, no dairy)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport with strict weight class requirements (boxer) needing a 2,000 calorie deficit meal plan while maintaining performance and muscle preservation

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading and optimal hydration for a 42km race the next day

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3,500+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 60-65% of total intake
Includes at least 3 hydration strategies (water intake, electrolyte beverages, or fluid-rich foods)
All meals and snacks are vegetarian and nut-free
Plan is formatted as a single day with specific meal times and portion sizes
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3,500+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration strategies

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength and power development for weightlifting competition with 2,800 calorie daily intake and high protein requirement

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2,800 calories across all meals
Protein intake meets or exceeds 160g (1.9g per kg bodyweight) distributed across meals
Includes pre-workout and post-workout nutrition strategically timed around training
Compact format with 4-5 meals presented concisely
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) requiring 2,800 calories with high protein intake and specific meal timing around training windows
